svg.title: The loss must not fight the activation
svg.desc: Size of the gradient on z for a sigmoid unit with target y=1 against z: cross-entropy is 1-a, squared error is a(1-a)^2. At z=-3 they are 0.953 and 0.043; squared error peaks at 0.148 at z=-0.693.
svg.text: The loss must not fight the activation
